en.askTitle: Put in your own degree, scores and funding, and get the same honest German master's budget and deadline plan
en.runTitle: Pune to Germany: a tuition-free English-taught master's for October 2027 on about INR 15 lakh of family money

fields.label: Nationality, degree, awarding university and modules
Confirmed funding: amount and source
fields.value: About INR 15 lakh in total, from family

fields.label: Loan or scholarship status
fields.placeholder: e.g. education loan approved for INR 8 lakh, no scholarship yet

fields.label: APS and dMAT status
fields.placeholder: e.g. APS not yet applied, dMAT not yet booked

en.template: Compare German MSc options for my {profile}, {grading}, {ielts} and {intake}. My confirmed funding is {funding}, with {aid} and {status}. Show subject-fit gates, complete application deadlines, the full-degree budget at {fx} and accessible arrival cash. Plan only; do not contact, apply, register or pay.

phases.title: Check four universities' programmes, entry rules, fees and deadlines on their own pages
phases.note: Magdeburg, Dortmund, Bremen and Freiberg, plus the official visa and living-cost rules
phases.judgment: A university page contradicted itself: the Bremen Space Engineering page carried an admission paragraph for a different programme. It used the binding admission regulation instead, and would not turn a 7.8 CGPA into a promise of eligibility or quote an unverified grade cut-off.

phases.title: Confirm visa funds, the APS certificate, insurance and living costs, then build the budget
phases.note: Blocked account, health insurance, student housing and the new dMAT test
phases.judgment: It checked the new dMAT requirement on APS India's own page rather than assuming: every B.Tech is in scope for winter 2027/28, with a published €150 fee, but not every master's applicant. That turned into a timing warning in the plan.

phases.title: Write the plan page and sources list, then check the arithmetic and the layout
phases.judgment: The answer to the family's question was stated plainly: at an openly labelled ₹110 per euro, a tuition-free two-year plan needs about ₹35.09 lakh including deposit and reserve, not ₹15 lakh. The arithmetic and the desktop and phone layouts were checked.

workers: Read the official pages of four English-taught engineering master's (Magdeburg, Dortmund, Bremen, Freiberg) for entry rules, English level, fees and deadlines
Checked blocked-account fees, the APS certificate and dMAT test, health insurance, student work rules and student-residence rents

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的学位、成绩和资金，就能得到同样诚实的德国硕士预算与截止日期计划
zh.runTitle: 从浦那到德国：用约 15 拉克卢比家庭资金，申请 2027 年 10 月入学的免学费英文授课硕士

fields.label: 国籍、学位、授予大学及课程
fields.value: 印度籍；机械工程 BTech，浦那

fields.label: 已落实资金：金额及来源
fields.value: 家庭支持，总共约 15 拉克卢比

fields.label: 贷款或奖学金状态
fields.placeholder: 例如：已批教育贷款 8 拉克卢比，暂无奖学金

fields.label: APS 和 dMAT 状态
fields.placeholder: 例如：APS 尚未申请，dMAT 尚未预约

fields.label: 汇率假设
fields.placeholder: 例如：1 欧元兑 105 卢比

zh.template: 请按我的{profile}、{grading}、{ielts}和{intake}，比较德国硕士选项。已落实资金是{funding}，贷款或奖学金状态为{aid}，APS 和 dMAT 状态为{status}。列出学科匹配门槛、完整材料截止日期、按{fx}计算的全学位预算，以及落地可动用现金。只做计划，不联系、不申请、不注册、不付款。

phases.title: 在四所大学自己的页面上核对课程、入学要求、费用和截止日期
phases.note: 马格德堡、多特蒙德、不来梅、弗莱贝格，加上官方签证与生活费规则
phases.judgment: 有一所大学的页面自相矛盾：不来梅航天工程硕士页面里混进了另一个专业的录取说明。它改以有约束力的录取条例为准，也没有把 7.8 的 CGPA 说成稳过，更没有引用查不到出处的分数线。

phases.title: 确认签证资金、APS 证书、保险和生活费，再搭预算
phases.note: 封锁账户、医疗保险、学生宿舍，以及新出的 dMAT 考试
phases.judgment: 新出的 dMAT 要求，它直接到 APS 印度官网核对而没有想当然：所有 B.Tech 都在范围内，适用于 2027/28 冬季学期，公布费用 150 欧元，但并非所有硕士申请人都要考。这一点后来变成计划里的时间预警。

phases.title: 写出计划页和来源清单，再检查算术与排版
phases.judgment: 它把家里最想知道的答案直接说清：按明确标注的 1 欧元 = 110 卢比，免学费的两年计划含押金和备用金约需 35.09 拉克卢比，而不是 15 拉克。算术以及电脑和手机排版都核对过。

workers: 阅读四所英文授课工科硕士(马格德堡、多特蒙德、不来梅、弗莱贝格)的官方页面，核对入学条件、英语要求、费用和截止日期
核对封锁账户收费、APS 证书和 dMAT 考试、医疗保险、学生打工规则以及学生宿舍租金
